summary: Governor test mounts the real Dashboard on fake task dicts and asserts the turn cell is exactly 'held 2' with style == 'dim' for a turn=user, attention=False governor with 2 non-terminal + 1 COMPLETE child (terminal child excluded from N), while sibling cases pin the boundaries: all-terminal governor renders yellow 'user', attention=True governor renders yellow 'user', blocked governor renders red.
